rubric_adherence.reason: The grader scored all nine applicable items and gave each one full marks. Every award matches the evidence in the submission. Diagram: there is one central process named 'Hệ thống xếp lịch phòng học', drawn as a 200x200 ellipse, which makes it a circle. The two external actors 'Giảng viên' and 'Dịch vụ lịch phòng' are named correctly and sit outside it, and there are no subprocesses or data stores. All four flows point the right way and are labelled exactly as the rubric requires, so both 0.75-point pairs were correctly awarded. Use-case spec: it gives the case name and primary actor, a precondition (logged in and authorised), a trigger (opening the function) and a success state (hold confirmed, booking saved, booking code issued). The main flow covers the search criteria, the query and the hold through the room service, saving only after the hold succeeds, and returning the booking code. Exception 4a covers the conflict: the booking is not saved, the room is reported busy, and the list reloads so the lecturer can choose again. NFR: it targets response time for room-availability search under peak load. All four measurement parts are present: a 2-second limit, 95% of searches, 100 concurrent lecturers, and timing from sending the query to the list appearing. That correctly earns the all-or-nothing 1.5 points. The grader invented no extra requirements and made no contradictory deductions, and the summary and section feedback match the item scores.
